headline: Why Fair Isaac Corporation (FICO) Stock Is Trading Lower Today
summary: Shares of credit scoring and analytics company FICO (NYSE:FICO) fell 6.8% in the afternoon session after Wolfe Research downgraded the stock to Peer Perform from Outperform, following a recent third-quarter revenue miss. The analyst firm pointed to competitive pressure from VantageScore as a growing concern. headline: FICO Q2 Deep Dive: Mortgage Market Volatility and Platform Expansion Shape Outlook
summary: Credit scoring and analytics company FICO (NYSE:FICO) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, but sales rose 25.7% year on year to $674.2 million. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $2.53 billion at the midpoint came in 0.9% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $12.18 per share was 3.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
